posts.title: Ford ships first in-house LFP battery cells using CATL tech in push for affordable EVs
posts.summary:
The plant's assembly lines can produce 40 cells per minute, making them among the fastest prismatic LFP battery lines outside China.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Ford has commenced production of LFP battery cells at its Michigan plant using licensed CATL technology, marking the automaker's first in-house battery manufacturing effort.
The facility utilizes high-speed assembly lines capable of producing 40 cells per minute, with output intended for the upcoming Fathom electric pickup truck.
Despite previous political scrutiny and project downsizing, the plant is now operational, with a supporting battery pack facility expected to come online in 2027.

posts.title: Xpeng to hold 2026 AI Day on November 25 with focus on physical AI and robotics
posts.summary:
Xpeng's humanoid robot Iron will interact live with the audience at the event, and the company will also showcase how Turing AI transforms vehicle experience.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Xpeng will host its 2026 AI Day on November 25, focusing on the co-evolution of physical AI models and robotic hardware.
The event will feature a live demonstration of the 'Iron' humanoid robot and showcase the integration of Turing AI in vehicle experiences.
The company is targeting mass production of its humanoid robot by late 2026 or early 2027, with deliveries expected in the second quarter of next year.

posts.title: Momenta, Uber launch supervised robotaxi pilot in Germany
posts.summary:
This marks the first time riders in Germany can experience a supervised autonomous ride through the Uber app.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Momenta and Uber have launched a supervised robotaxi pilot in Munich, representing the first time riders in Germany can access autonomous rides via the Uber app.
The service is currently non-commercial and free of charge, operating with a mandatory safety operator on board under KBA-approved test permits.
This pilot serves as a strategic expansion for Momenta, which aims to leverage its dual-track strategy of mass-market driver assistance and L4 autonomous mobility.

posts.title: Nvidia Earnings; Office Convergence; OS Wars, AI Edition
posts.summary: Nvidia's earnings were boring, and also a statement as to why Jensen Huang probably isn't coming back; then, Microsoft and Anthropic ship dueling operating system updates.
bullets: Nvidia's latest earnings report suggests a stabilization in performance that signals a shift away from the hyper-growth phase, potentially marking a transition in Jensen Huang's leadership focus.
Microsoft and Anthropic have launched competing operating system updates, highlighting a new front in the AI-driven battle for platform dominance.
The convergence of office software and AI operating systems indicates that the next phase of enterprise competition will be defined by how deeply AI is integrated into the fundamental user interface.

posts.title: The Download: AI learns to smell and hydropower struggles
posts.summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s In a New Jersey lab, researchers are trying to sniff every odor on Earth. Their careful notes—“nutty,” “peachy,”…
bullets: US Southwest hydropower generation dropped 28% below the 10-year average between April and August, highlighting significant climate-related risks to renewable energy infrastructure.
The AI startup Osmo is developing a foundation model for olfaction, claiming human-level performance in scent discrimination and fragrance design.
Modernizing the US power grid with solid-state transformers is becoming a strategic priority to manage the surging electricity demand from data centers and the broader AI infrastructure boom.
